text: Hardwired signals between DCS and TCS are limited to the ones needed for safe and autonomous operation of each system: start / stop commands, permissives, emergency stop (redundant), ready signals, run signals and trip-outs; the unit load set-point and the export limiter signal are transmitted in redundant analogue signals and as OPC UA values (ALP-EPC-00000-IC-CNR-0001).
